name: Europe Brent Spot Price FOB, daily (EIA RBRTEd)
source: U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA), Spot Prices, series RBRTE daily
publisher: U.S. Department of Energy / Energy Information Administration (EIA)
license: public domain (U.S. Government work); attribution/acknowledgment recommended
unit: USD per barrel, nominal (spot FOB, Europe Brent)
coverage: 1987-05-20 .. 2026-11-24; 9,137 daily observations (business days with a published value; latest data 2026-11-24, release date 2026-11-25)
notes: Compact two-column public-domain pin: date,value (USD/bbl), LF, UTF-8 without BOM, 9,137 business-day observations. The raw RBRTEd.xls (453,632 B) is NOT committed; only this derived aggregate is. Values are copied as published, no filling of holidays/weekends and no monthly aggregation. This is a dated snapshot, not a PIT/vintage archive: EIA may revise historical values. It is byte-identical to data/public/fred_brent_daily.csv (9,137 overlapping dates, 0 differing values, max abs diff 0.0) because FRED DCOILBRENTEU is a mirror of the same EIA series. It is a SPOT price, not an ICE/NYMEX futures settlement and not a contract curve; no volumes, open interest or term structure. Licences: EIA public domain (U.S. Government work), attribution recommended. See docs/251.
